about.title: About Barabari
about.mission_text: In an era of transformation, understanding the bedrock of a nation — its Constitution — is no longer a scholarly pursuit, but a civic necessity. We bridge the gap between legal complexity and public awareness by launching a comprehensive analytical platform dedicated to the Iranian people.
about.goal_text: To illuminate the profound impact of constitutional law on the daily lives of citizens. By dissecting the current Iranian legal structure and placing it alongside the diverse governance frameworks of the international community, we provide a mirror for reflection and a window for inspiration.
architecture_items: Deep analysis: Stripping away legal jargon to reveal core mechanisms
Global perspective: Examining how nations address fundamental freedoms
Data-driven comparison: Heat maps and popularity rankings
Collaborative vision: An intellectual laboratory for citizen participation
